figures.caption: Table 1: Comparison of Prober.ai with existing writing support paradigms.

Figure 1: Conceptual processing pipeline of Prober.ai. The LLM performs argument parsing, feature detection, epistemic state classification, trigger prioritization, and question module selection as internal reasoning steps. Only the final inquiry-based questions are surfaced to the student.

Figure 2: The Write–Challenge–Defend–Improve cycle. The loop is designed so that cognitive effort always precedes the delivery of suggestions, ensuring the student remains the primary agent of revision.
